city.persona: 붉은 성벽과 다채로운 돔, 강을 두른 고리길의 도시 — 차가운 겨울빛 속에서 보석 같은 색과 공연의 온기를 지킨다.

palette.en: brick crimson, enamel emerald and antique gold

city.design_note: 2026-11-26 gpt — 사용자 모스크바 판타지 요청으로 새 도시 설계. 상징·좌표·기후·생활 근거는 UNESCO와 Moscow 문서. 직업과 마법·미래 풍경은 창작 해석이다. 세 세계는 얼굴·머리·체형이 다른 러시아인 성인 여성. 정치 문장·국장·실존 인물·상표 없이 건축의 색과 구조를 옷의 자수·법랑·금속 장식으로 옮긴다.

fantasy.en: a magnificent myth-world capital on a winding river, red-brick ramparts crowned with tapering spires, colourful bulbous roofs covered in emerald spirals and ruby diamonds, gilded palace arcades and enchanted lanterns glowing over snow-dusted stone terraces

scenes.en: on a snowy stone terrace above the winding river, red ramparts and colourful spiral-patterned domes behind her
beneath a gilded palace arcade, clear light falling across patterned stone and deep crimson hanging fabrics
a gilded worktable in a vaulted enamel workshop beside the red fortress walls, a small unfinished emerald ward medallion on a padded tray

look.why: 붉은 성벽의 법랑 결계사 — 도시 상징에서 만든 창작 직업. 다른 세계와 얼굴·머리·체형을 분리한다.

hold.en: a slender gilded wand with an emerald enamel lozenge held securely at its tip

motif.ko: 붉은 성벽의 법랑 결계사 — 도시 문양을 옮긴 의상
motif.en: a fitted crimson-and-gold breastplate inlaid with emerald spiral enamel and diamond-shaped ruby panels, a scalloped belt echoing the fortress battlements, pearl-edged ivory cape and a sweeping split overskirt; the architecture appears as decorative patterns on wearable clothing

steampunk.en: a gaslit fairy-tale capital on the winding river, red-brick towers with polished brass roof ribs, grand theatres with glass canopies, white steam curling from elegant river launches and brass-trimmed carriages, warm lamps beneath enamel-coloured domes

scenes.en: on a riverside terrace overlooking the city and its gaslit brass-trimmed towers
beneath a gilded palace arcade, clear light falling across patterned stone and deep crimson hanging fabrics
the brass-railed lighting gallery of a grand gaslit theatre, polished lenses and hand-operated lamp shutters beside a velvet stage curtain

look.why: 가스등 극장 조명 기사 — 도시 상징에서 만든 창작 직업. 다른 세계와 얼굴·머리·체형을 분리한다.

hold.en: a polished brass theatre-light focusing tool with a wooden grip

motif.ko: 가스등 극장 조명 기사 — 도시 문양을 옮긴 의상
motif.en: a fitted long crimson theatre-technician coat with emerald enamel lapels, brass arc-shaped shoulder frames echoing theatre prosceniums, a utility belt of small glass lenses and pearl-white gloves

cyberpunk.ko: 고리 노선이 하늘로 솟은 미래 도시
cyberpunk.en: a far-future Moscow two centuries on, concentric maglev rings woven through towering garden arcologies, the old red fortress preserved under a transparent climate shell, riverside decks floating above the water and orbital transit spires linked by emerald light

scenes.en: on a riverside terrace overlooking the city and its suspended transit rings and garden arcologies
beneath a gilded palace arcade, clear light falling across patterned stone and deep crimson hanging fabrics
a suspended transit-design studio high above the river, concentric luminous route models hovering over a clear work surface

hold.en: a palm-sized translucent route prism casting concentric rings of emerald light
